## More basic functionality

You can instrument functions inside your code with the `@operation` decorator, which will create spans that track function execution, parameters, and return values. These operations will be displayed in your session visualization alongside LLM calls.
  ```python python
  # Instrument a function as an operation
  from agentops.sdk.decorators import operation

@operation
  def process_data(data):
      # Your function logic here
      result = data.upper()
      return result
```

skill_drafts.name: Function Instrumentation with Operation Decorator
skill_drafts.description: Decorate Python functions with @operation to automatically create execution spans that track function calls, parameters, and return values for session visualization.
applicable_signals: custom function defined in agent codebase
function execution needs to be correlated with LLM calls
contraindications: function is already instrumented by another tracing mechanism
only LLM call monitoring is required without custom function tracking
function is part of a third-party library with its own instrumentation
workflow_steps: apply @operation decorator to target function definition
function executes normally with decorator active
span is automatically created and added to session visualization
triggers: need to track execution and parameters of custom functions
want to visualize custom function calls alongside LLM calls in session
require observability into function behavior during agent execution
constraints: function must be defined in user code (not external library)
agentops SDK must be initialized in the session
decorator must be imported from agentops.sdk.decorators
cautions: decorator adds minimal overhead but may impact performance on very high-frequency function calls
return values are captured; ensure sensitive data is not logged
output_contract: decorated function executes normally and produces a span visible in session visualization with function name, parameters, and return value

examples.input: function: process_data(data) that transforms input string to uppercase
examples.output: span created in session visualization showing process_data call with parameter data and return value
examples.notes: decorator requires no modification to function logic

metadata.prompt: Apply the @operation decorator from agentops.sdk.decorators to any Python function you want to monitor. The decorator will automatically capture function execution, input parameters, and return values as spans in your session visualization, displayed alongside LLM calls.
